summary: Typosquat with preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: This unscoped package impersonates the Ornikar-scoped @ornikar/babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined: package.json lists repository ornikar/babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined and author Christophe Hurpeau, and lib/index.js is a verbatim copy of the legitimate babel visitor, but the tarball adds a preinstall entry ("node setup.mjs") that has no relation to the advertised babel plugin. setup.mjs checks for bun on the installer's PATH and, when absent, downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<VER>/<arch>.zip into a temporary directory, extracts it, chmod +x's the bun binary, and immediately execFileSyncs that freshly downloaded runtime against the sibling math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header "// @bun @bun-cjs") laid out as a string-array obfuscator: large numeric/string constant table and a decoder function that reconstructs strings at runtime. The obfuscated payload runs automatically on npm install under an alternate runtime that Node-oriented tooling cannot inspect, giving the publisher arbitrary code execution on every installer's machine. A ~80-line babel AST plugin has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an obfuscated multi-hundred-kilobyte bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
